messages.subject: pairs of inputSelects reactively connected update problem
parts:
Hi,

I have the following problem and cannot figure out how to get around it.

What I do is very basic: First I upload a data file, the I select a few variables of it in in a selectInput widget.

Based on that selection for each variable an array of widget is presented, packed into one wellPannel(div(...)) wrapper.

The first two of those widgets are inputSelect widgets of which the first one selects one of the previously determined variables and the second one as a reactive respone presents the differen values of that selected single variable.

However, what happens is: I change the selection in the first inputSelect, then the screen updates so that the second inputSelect show the rigth values, but the first one is reseted to its default value.
As a consequence the screen updates again so that the second inputSelect switches back to its initial value aswell.

This is the current code for one variable:

        conditionalPanel("input.checkfile",
        wellPanel(
            h5("Please select the targeted proportions for each variable:"),
                div(class = "row offset1",   
                conditionalPanel(n.vars() > 0,
                div(class = "span3", wellPanel(
                    selectInput("var1propselect", "Select variable:", give.varnames(), give.varnames()[1]),
                    selectInput("var1valueselect", "Select target value:",
                                as.list(give.valuelabels()[[selected.order()[1]]])),
                     sliderInput("var1propslider", "Set proportion range:",
                                    0,1,value = c(0,1),step = 0.05,animate=FALSE),
                    helpText("__________________________"),
                     selectInput("var1proplink","Link with variable (optional):",c(list("none"),give.varnames())),
                    sliderInput("var1weightslider", "Set relative weight of variable (optional):",
                                0,1,value = 1,step = 0.01,animate=FALSE))
                )),
               ...
        )

So what seems to be the problem that by updating selectInput("var1valueselect",...)  in the same moment selectInput("var1propselect",...) gets rerendered with its default value.
What I could imagine to solve the problem could be a replacement for give.varnames()[1] that actually stores the value of the selection in selectInput("var1propselect",...) from before the whole div gets updated and sets the new default value for the widget.

Any ideas how to do this or something better?

Best,
WF

messages.subject: Re: pairs of inputSelects reactively connected update problem
parts:
hi,

sorry I do not have the time right now to write an example, but I solved the problem and will explain it in short:

- I had an renderUI object which was an array of widgets within a html-division
- arguments of of the different widget partially were dependent on the input-values derived from other widgets within the same division
- user input one widget "1" updated the dependend ones as intended, but causes also rerendering of the whole division resulting in setting widget "1" back to its default value, which then of course reseted the dependend widgets (pain!)

solution:

- input arguments of widget "1" for exaple has to look like:

widget("widget_input_id", "name", value.arguement = isolate(input$widget_input_id))

- I think this only works for a "value.argument" that can take the value NULL, because this is the value the "input$widget_input_id" takes before the widget actually exists


Hope it helps...
WF
